newsitem.title: SPAIN: Speculative interest boosts Banesto shares.
newsitem.headline: Speculative interest boosts Banesto shares.

text.p: Shares in Spanish bank Banesto continued to storm higher on Tuesday but traders were still at odds over the exact reason for the rise.

The bank's shares have clocked up more than 40 percent in the last 12 sessions since December 13. By 1355 GMT on Tuesday, Banesto shares had risen 13.43 percent, or 145 pesetas, to 1,225, after touching a record high of 1,240 earlier in the session.
"Everyone is asking why Banesto is rising and nobody really knows," said an analyst at one bank in Madrid.

One theory offered by traders was that shares were rallying amid talk that Banco Santander was considering increasing its 53 percent stake in the bank. However, others cited the exact opposite: that Santander may reduce its holding.
Talk that a new chairman may be on the cards also wafted through the market, traders said, as did expectations for a strong increase in profits for 1996.
